tei:div.tei:p: 207): chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig las: mkha' 'gro gsang ba 'dus pa'i don dbang skal ldan rjes 'dzin zab rgya can bzhugs so: 208)

na mo gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki ni ye: rang rig rtsa gsum lha la 'dud: bdag nyid pad+ma thod phreng gi: ma 'ongs rjes 'jug skyes bu kun: gsang sngags lam la 'jug pa'i thabs: mkha' 'gro'i dbang chog zab mo bstan: skal ldan bu yis nyams su longs: sa ma ya: de yang sta gon rim pa ni: dkyil 'khor bum pa bhan+dha dang: rig ma shel rdo a dar+sha: sku tsaka gtor ma la sogs pa: rim pa legs par bshams nas kyang: slob dpon chas gsol bdag dbang blangs: skal ldan slob bu mdun du 'khod: khrus byas bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bsgom: lo rgyus 'chad cing dbang yon phul: de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni: kyai: gsang sngags 'chang ba rdo rje 'chang: dbang ldan rgyal po bla ma rje: bdag cag skal ldan bu rnams la: smin byed dbang gi bka' drin stsol: lan gsum brjod: slob dpon gyis: e ma: rigs ldan skyes bu rnams: gsang sngags smin byed ngas bskur gyi: dam tshig chen po srog ltar zungs: tshul bzhin bsrung ba tha tshig go: dam mi ldan rnams phyir dengs shig: de nas skyabs sems 'bogs nas sdom bzung ni: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon mchog nyid dgongs: bdag cag skal ldan bu rnams la: thun mong 209)dang ni thun min gyi: bslab gsum bdag la bstsal du gsol: bsgo ba'i bka' bzhin mi nyams par: srog gi phyir du mi gtong ngo: tshul bzhin bdag gis bsrung nus sam: lan gsum brjod nas dam chu thogs: kyai: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: rdo rje'i dam tshig chu 'di blud: 'di 'thung dam tshig tshul bzhin srungs: tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur: nyams na rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung: de phyir ma 'da' sa ma ya: na ra kan: de nas mig ras me tog sbyin pa ni: khyed rang rnams kyi ma rig pa'i ling thog bsal ba'i phyir ras yug dmar po res gdong bcings ba'i mos pa mdzod: tsak+ṣu bhan+dha wa ra ma ṇa ye swā hāḥ lhag pa'i lha dang mjal ba'i phyir me tog gi phreng bar re 'dzin pa'i mos pa mdzod:

a khaṃ wi ra hūm̐: de nas slob ma lhar gsal ba ni: oṃ ma hā bū n+ya ta sogs nas: ko3haṃḥ skad cig slob ma'i ma dag gdos bcas sbyangs: dag pa 'od lus rig pa bam̐ yig mthing: 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas tshur 'dus: yongs gyur skad cig slob ma rnams: 210)rdo rje phag mo sogs nas las gzhung spyan 'dren bcas bya: de nas ye shes dbab pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ yul gyi ming ni 'og min chen po'i zhing: gnas kyi ming ni dur khrod gsang chen rol: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro'i grong khyer nas: rdo rje phag mo rgyal kun dgyes pa'i yum: gdul dka' 'dul phyir drag mo'i sku ru bzhengs: 'khor du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: chos kyi dbyings nas gzugs kyi skur bzhengs la: rnal 'byor byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: lus la mi 'gyur sku yi byin chen phobs: ngag la 'gags med gsung gi byin chen phobs: sems la 'khrul med thugs kyi byin chen phobs: sgo gsum mi 'gyur rdo rje gsum du rlobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub byin chen phobs: gnas yul dur khrod he ru'i gnas bcu sogs: rang bzhin rnam dag zhing mchog na: bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs: chos kyi dbyings nas gzugs kyi skur bzhengs la: rnal 'byor byin gyis sogs: byin chen phobs: kun tu bzang mo'i sgyu 'phrul dbyings kyi yum: 'jig 'das srung ma dam can tshogs kyis bskor: chos kyi dbyings nas gzugs kyi skur bzhengs la: rnal 'byor byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: 211)bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad ma lus sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub byin chen phobs: byin rlabs ye shes sprin phung thibs se thib: gsang gsum dngos grub char rgyun si li li: phaṭa dang pheṃ sgra mang po sangs se sang: ḍā ki'i snyan pa'i bshugs glu dbyangs dang bcas: sgrub mchog bu yi sgo gsum smin pa dang:

sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi: dbang stsol rtogs grol dus mnyam byin chen phobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus stsol: oṃ gu ru badz+ra bha ra ka li he hūm̐ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrīḥya e a ra li pheṃ pheṃ a be sha ya ā āḥ me tog 'thor nas brtan par bya: de nas: hoḥ rig pa'i me tog lha la 'bul: sngon gyi yi dam lhar babs nas: lha de'i rjes su bzung nas kyang: dngos grub rnam gnyis thob par shog: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sid+dhi trām̐: de nas mig dar bsal ba ni: hoḥ rig pa ye shes sangs rgyas dngos: sgrib gnyis bag chags mun pas bsgribs: glo bur dri ma'i skyon gyis gos: rdo rje slob dpon thabs ldan ngas: rig pa gser gyi thur ma yis: ye shes gsal ba'i 212)spyan du dbye: dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭaḥ de nas dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni: e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu: rang byung rig pa byang chub sems: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i bdag: dbyer med chen por lhun gyis grub: 'bad rtsol bral ba rig pa'i gshis: 'du 'bral med do rang la rdzogs: ngo shes rtsal rdzogs brtan thob gyis: 'bras bu bla med sangs rgyas thob: dkyil 'khor chen po gzhan na med: shes par mdzod cig rigs kyi bu: a a dz+nyā na bh+rūm̐ maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐: de nas dngos gzhi'i dbang zhu ba la maṇ+ḍal phul: gsol ba gdab pa ni: kyai: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: bdag cag skal ldan bu rnams la: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dngos gzhi'i dbang: yongs rdzogs dam pa bstsal du gsol: lan gsum brjod nas bum pa thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ phyi ni bum pa nang ni bdud rtsis bkang: gsang bar mkha' 'gro'i sku yi bkod pa rdzogs: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: 'gyur med sku yi dbang mchog thob par shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de bas bdud rtsi thogs la: hūm̐: rang byung mtshan ldan bhan+dha bdud rtsis bkang:

rang gsal gsung dbyangs a li ka li 'phro: 213)skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: 'gags med gsung gsang rgyan 'khor dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas chos 'byung bam̐ yig thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ spros mtha' brgyad bral kun zlum thig le'i klong: mi shigs dga' bzhi'i chos 'byung zur bzhi mdzes: ting 'dzin sems dpa' bam̐ yig mtshan pa yis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs gsang mi zad pa: rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dbang mchog thob par shog: rtsa sngags: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rig ma gtad pa la yon phul: gsol ba gdab pa ni: hoḥ gsang sngags bdag po bla ma dgongs: bdag cag skal ldan bu rnams la: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i shes rab dbang: gsang sngags dkyil 'khor 'jug pa'i lam: yongs rdzogs bka' drin bstsal du gsol: lan gsum brjod nas slob dpon gyis: e ma: rigs bzang skal bar ldan pa'i bu: thabs mang dka' ba med pa yi: gsang sngags lam la 'jug spro na: skal ldan khyod la bdag gis stsal: ngas bsgo'i bka' las mi 'da' bar: rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig rnams: ma nyams tshul bzhin bsrung bar gyis: bud med mi smad spang mi bya: 214)mtshan ldan mu dra bkur zhing mchod: thabs shes snying po'i myur lam bgrod: de phyir dam tshig ma 'da' srungs: badz+ra sa ma ya na ra kan: de nas rig ma sbyin pa ni: e ma: rigs bzang skal ldan sems kyi bu: chos dbyings ngang las rang byung sgyu 'phrul gar: bcu drug dga' ster mchog gi pho nya mo: yid 'ong mtshan bzang ldan pa'i mdza' na mo: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: 'khor lo lnga yi mdud pa rang grol nas: dga' bzhis nyer drangs stong bzhi'i 'od gsal mthong: lus dang rtsa yi khams dag sprul pa'i sku: ngag rlung khams dag longs spyod rdzogs skur smin: yid dang thig le gnas dag chos skur rdzogs: bde stong zung 'jug chen po'i dbang thob shog:

rtsa sngags: ma hā mu dra bho dhi tsit+ta a haṃ su kha sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas me long shel rdo mdongs lnga thogs la: āḥ rig pa gdod nas spros bral chos kyi sku: skye 'gags 'gyur med ye shes lhun gyis grub: chos kun ma 'dres rang gsal brda yi dbang: shel rdo me long 'od lnga 'di gtad pas: ka dag tshig gi dbang mchog thob par shog: rtsa sngags: a a āḥ 215) ngo sprad pa ni: e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu rnams kun: ma yengs sems nyid ma bcos ngang du ltos: blta bya lta byed gnyis med nam mkha'i ngang: ngo bo stong pa rang gsal kun tu khyab: sku gsum mnyam nyid chos dbyings mtha' dbus bral: stong gsal nam mkha' 'di ni sangs rgyas dngos: de las gzhan nas sangs rgyas yod ma yin: gdod nas rang byung rnam dag kun tu bzang: mkha' dbyings khyab brdal stong pa kun bzang mo: gnyis su med pa'i rang byung ye shes ni: bsam du med la brjod pa kun dang bral: ye grol bskyar gzhi med pa'i rang grol klong: sems dang chos nyid nam mkha' tha dad med: 'dzin med klong yangs nam mkha'i ngang du zhog: kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon po de ka'o: tshe gcig don gyi sangs rgyas e ma hoḥ de nas gtso mo'i sku thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ chos nyid gzhi las ma g.yos drag mo'i sku: gdul dka' 'dul mdzad rdo rje phag mo yis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: sku yi yon tan rdzogs pa'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: mkha' 'gro lnga'i sku thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ khro mo'i gnas lnga'i rang byung 216)dkyil 'khor du: chu khams rnam dag yum chen ma ki ma: rnam shes gnas dag sems dpa' gnyis med 'khril: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: me long ye shes mngon gyur dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐ hrīḥ me khams rnam dag yum chen gos dkar mo: 'du shes gnas dag sems dpa'=

skal ldan rigs= sor rtogs= rtsa sngags: kā ya= hūm̐ hrīḥ nam mkha' rnam dag yum chen dbyings phyug ma: gzugs phung gnas dag= skal ldan= chos dbyings ye shes= rtsa sngags: kā ya= hūm̐ hrīḥ sa khams rnam dag yum chen sangs rgyas spyan: tshor phung gnas= skal ldan= mnyam nyid ye shes= rtsa sngags: kā ya= hūm̐ hrīḥ rlung khams rnam dag yum chen dam tshig sgrol: 'du byed gnas dag= skal ldan= bya grub ye shes= rtsa sngags: kā ya= de nas gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro bzhi'i sku thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ khro mo'i thugs klong rang byung tsit+ta'i dbus: shar du shes rab 'od rtsa dwangs pa'i sbubs: dga' ba'i rang gzugs bde chen mchog gi yum: dkar gsal khro 'dzum 'od kyi phung po can: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: snang stong dbyer med mchog gi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: 217)kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐ hrīḥ lho ru ye shes 'od rtsa dwangs pa'i dbus: mchog dga'i rang gzugs bde chen stong pa'i yum: khro 'dzum ser gsal 'od kyi phung po can: skal ldan= gsal stong dbyer med= rtsa sngags: kā ya= hūm̐ hrīḥ nub tu rang byung 'od rtsa dwangs pa'i dbus: lhan dga'i rang gzugs bde chen mchog stsol ma: khro 'dzum dmar gsal 'od kyi phung po can: skal ldan= bde stong dbyer med= rtsa sngags: kā ya= hūm̐ hrīḥ byang du 'od gsal 'od rtsa dwangs pa'i dbus: khyad dga'i rang gzugs bde ba chen po'i yum: khro 'dzum mthing gsal 'od kyi phung po can: skal ldan= rig stong dbyer med= rtsa sngags: kā ya= de nas sa bon brgyad thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ khro mo rdo rje sku yi dkyil 'khor du: rang byung sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul drwa ba'i sprin: gnas yul dur khrod he ru'i zhing gtso: dpa' bo dang ni dpa' mo rnal 'byor ma: gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor ye nas rdzogs: ting 'dzin sems dpa' thugs srog sa bon 'dis: skal ldan= snang rtog lha skur rdzogs pa'i dbang thob shog:

rtsa sngags: kā ya= de nas sgo ma bzhi'i sku thogs la: 218)hūm̐ hrīḥ tshad med bzhi yi rang gzugs phyag rgya'i gar: las bzhir dbang mdzad ye shes sgo ma bzhi: skal ldan rigs kyi= las kun thogs med bsgrub pa'i dbang thob shog: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ khyab brdal pags pa bhan+dha'i snod nang du: rang byung lhun grub dpal gyi gtor ma bshams: ye shes 'od lnga rgyan gyis rnam par spras: ma mo mkha' 'gro sgrub pa'i dam tshig rten: skal ldan rigs kyi= dngos grub rnam gnyis thob pa'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: sarba ma hā ba liṃ ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bka' dbang ni: hoḥ chos sku kun bzang yab yum: drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen: ston pa rdo rje sems dpa': gu ru dga' rab rdo rje: paṇa chen bi ma mi tra: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas: mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo: nam snying rgyal mo g.yu sgra: mkha' spyod su kha sid+dhi: mkha' 'gro rdo rje zhi ba mtsho: ma gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro: sku sprul dkar mo bzhad ma: gsung sprul dmar mo sgra sgrogs: thugs sprul nag mo zil gnon: yon tan ser mo don grub: phrin las sna tshogs mthar phyin: yang sprul zhing rdul grangs mnyam gyi mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum sde: 219)ye shes dang las las grub pa'i gnas yul zhing skyong gi dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis rdo rje'i slob ma rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams la dbang bskur bar mdzad du gsol: sgrib gnyis bag chags thams cad lhag med du dag nas phyi nang gi yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing snang rtog lha'i phyag rgyar rtogs nas dag mnyam chos sku chen po nang gsal gzhon nu bum skur sangs rgyas par gyur cig: ces brjod nas me tog 'thor: de nas bka' drin gso zhing dam tshig khas blangs bya: dge bsngo la sogs bkra shis me tog 'thor:

las rjes mi mngon gsang bar bya: sa ma ya: e ma bde chen ye shes mkha' 'gro yi: don dbang yang zab snying po 'di: snying mig srog las phongs na yang: mkhar chen mtsho rgyal khyod la gdams: ma 'ongs rjes 'jug bu'i don du: mi 'gyur gsang ba'i gter du sbos: snyigs 'dus 'gro ba'i mun sel du: khyo sprul shar gyi phyogs nas 'byung: smon lam dbang gis chos 'dir 'phrad: nga min nga nyid grogs dang ni: chos 'dzin skyes bu'i tshul du 'ong: de dus bstan la rim bzhin sman: gcig brgyud ma gtogs spel mi rung: bka' srung gza' dang ma mor gnyer: skal ldan bu dang 'phrad par shog: skal med log lta can la ni: rlung phyogs tsam yang spel mi rung: spel na mkha' 'gros chad pa 'bebs: 220) gnod sbyin shan pas thub par srungs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gu rgya: brda thim: ces pa 'di yang gter chen chos kyi rgyal po mtshan brjod par dka' na'ang don gyi slad du rig 'dzin pad+ma 'gro 'dul gsang sngags gling pas bka' bskul spyi bor son tshe 'khor 'bangs kun gyi tha shal ba gter brdzun kun bzang bde skyong dbang mos ne gro rdo rje rdzong gi gnas 'dabs nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nas mkha' 'gro'i 'phrul brda gsang ba'i shog ser las zhal bshus pa'o// dge'o//
